description: Eswatini - Altitude is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by Min Jaegal (World Bank Group). This dataset contains the topography of Eswatini. The format is in tif. Coverage: Eswatini. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
